name: ioctl_tty
description: The ioctl function for TTY devices manipulates terminal and serial port settings. It accepts various operation arguments to get or set attributes, but its use is non-portable and POSIX alternatives like those in termios(3) should be preferred.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the terminal or serial line

parameters.name: op
parameters.description: Operation code, such as TCGETS or TIOCGWINSZ, specifying the action to perform

parameters.name: arg
parameters.description: Optional third argument, varying by operation, often a pointer to a structure like struct termios

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and sets errno to indicate the error

bugs: Incompatible struct termios definitions between <asm/termbits.h> and <termios.h>; some ioctls not supported on all architectures, and behavior varies across systems for certain arguments.
versions: Various ioctls added in Linux 2.6.20 and later
